tasks.name: Hybrid Luikov inverse: M9-Dirichlet top + M15-tin bottom + alpha(T)
tasks.deliverable: src/data/spatial_reconstruction/luikov_dirichlet_hybrid.py: forward solver with M9-style Dirichlet top BC (T(x_surface, t) = T_observed_at_M2a_surface_position(t) directly anchored to observation, no h_top or T_oven_eff parameters), M15-style asymmetric-tin bottom BC with q_bottom_eff coupling, alpha(T) piecewise profile with alpha_ratio free parameter, real probe geometry. 5 free params: L, D, Lu, q_bottom_eff, alpha_ratio. tests/test_luikov_dirichlet_hybrid_research.py: forward sanity, synthetic recovery, real-CSV viability, LOO subset. tests/_driver_luikov_dirichlet_hybrid.py: end-to-end driver. tests/baselines/luikov_dirichlet_hybrid_research.md: report with comparison vs M9 (5-11 deg C), M15 (6.1 deg C), M16 (37 deg C). NOT wired into runtime classifier.
tasks.validation_required: Forward sanity passes (Dirichlet @ surface, asymmetric tin bottom, alpha(T) transition). Synthetic recovery within 30 percent on at least 1 case. Real-CSV joint inverse converges on at least 5 of 7 fixtures with at least 3 of 5 parameters interior. LOO subset includes T1 and T2 held-out RMSE. Existing M1-M16 tests untouched.
